title: Contract Triggers: Billing–Forecast Synchronization Operational Matrix
author: Maya Chen
content:
Overview

This document defines the operational matrix and step-by-step procedures that align contract life-cycle events with billing, forecasting, procurement triggers, and revenue recognition (RevRec) treatment. It is intended for Finance, Legal, Sales Ops, Revenue Operations, and Engineering teams that integrate contract state changes into operational and financial systems.

Why this doc exists
- Reduce lag between contract events (sign, amendment, renewal, termination) and downstream systems (billing engine, forecasting models, procurement commitments, RevRec journal entries).
- Standardize thresholds and handoffs to avoid missed revenue, overstated forecasts, or procurement exposure.
- Provide clear ownership, SLAs, and templates for automation.

Scope
- Applies to all customer contracts (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private) and purchase orders that create recurring revenue or material one-time fees.
- Excludes internal vendor contracts (procurement team maintains separate catalog) unless they affect cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) commitments.

Key definitions
- Contract Trigger: A discrete event that should change state in billing/forecast/RevRec (e.g., Signed, Effective Date, Amendment>10% ARR, Renewal, Early Termination, Billing Dispute > $25k).
- Forecast Adjustment Window: 3 business days for High-impact triggers, 7 business days for Medium, 15 business days for Low.
- High-impact: Event has >$250k ARR impact or materially changes SaaS revenue recognition pattern.

Operational Matrix (condensed)
| Trigger | Impacted Systems | Forecast Action | Billing Action | RevRec Treatment | Owner | SLA |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---:|
| New Contract Signed (ARR >= $250k) | Forecast, Billing Engine, RevRec, Legal | Flag M0 forecast; create upward adjustment in revenue plan | Create invoice schedule; enable initial invoice | Determine performance obligations; bill and recognize per ASC 606 schedule | Sales Ops / Finance | 3 business days |
| Contract Amendment (+/- >=10% ARR) | Forecast, Billing, RevRec | Apply delta to forecast with sensitivity notes | Update subscription items; prorate next invoice | Reassess standalone selling prices; adjust recognized revenue | Finance + Legal | 3 business days |
| Renewal (auto / negotiated) | Forecast, Billing | Renew line item in forecast; note churn uplift | Roll forward billing schedule; apply renewal pricing | Continue recognition unless change in terms | Account Exec / Revenue Ops | 7 business days |
| Early Termination (customer request) | Forecast, Billing, RevRec, Procurement | Remove recognized forward revenue beyond termination; model churn hit | Stop future invoices; issue final settlement | Recognize or reverse deferred revenue per contract terms | Finance + Legal | 3 business days |
| Billing Dispute > $25k | Billing, Finance, Legal | Flag forecast as at-risk; create contingent adjustment | Suspend new invoices for disputed items | Evaluate if revenue must be withheld; record liability if required | Billing + Finance | 2 business days acknowledgement; resolution per incident SLA |

Note: The full matrix (CSV) is maintained in the Revenue Ops shared drive and is the source for automated webhooks.

Procedures and Runbook (step-by-step)
1) New Contract (> $250k ARR):
   1.1 Sales uploads fully executed contract to Contract Repository (legal@redwood) and sets "Contract State" = Signed.
   1.2 Legal reviews executed doc and verifies Effective Date, Term, and Termination clauses within 24 hours.
   1.3 Sales Ops triggers the "contract.signed" webhook (see sample payload below) to Revenue Platform.
   1.4 Finance validates invoice schedule within 3 business days and flips forecast flag to "Material Booking".
   1.5 Revenue Ops routes to RevRec specialist to draft journal entries for the first month.

2) Amendment Workflow (+/- 10% ARR):
   2.1 Sales marks amendment in CRM and attaches amendment doc.
   2.2 Legal confirms amendment effective date and impact on PSUs/KPIs.
   2.3 Automated sync updates billing items and posts delta invoice(s).
   2.4 Finance issues forecast amendment note and updates rolling ARR model.

3) Renewal and Auto-Renew Notices:
   - 90-day renewal reminder triggers notification to Account Exec and Revenue Ops.
   - For auto-renew with price increase >5%, require Sales Ops approval and a customer communications plan.

Sample webhook payload (JSON)
{
  "event": "contract.signed",
  "contract_id": "C-2026-0582",
  "customer": "Acme Retail",
  "arr_delta": "320000",
  "effective_date": "2026-02-01",
  "term_months": "36",
  "billing_profile": "annual-in-advance",
  "attachments": ["s3://contracts/C-2026-0582.pdf"]
}

Forecasting integration patterns
- Push pattern: Sales Ops triggers an event; forecasting service ingests change and emits a delta in the weekly forecast snapshot.
- Pull pattern: Forecast engine polls contract repository nightly for state changes and validates totals vs billing ledger.
- Reconciliation cadence: Weekly automated reconciliation between billing ledger and forecast; threshold for manual investigation is a net delta > $50k.

Procurement and Cost Commitments
- For Dedicated and Private deployments that require procurement (customer-funded hardware, third-party licenses), treat procurement obligations as contingent liabilities until the PO is fully accepted.
- When a contract triggers vendor commitment > $100k, Procurement must be cc'd and register a purchase request within 5 business days.
- Procurement template (YAML) for purchase requests:

purchase_request:
  requester: "account-team@example.com"
  amount_usd: 135000
  vendor: "EdgeInfra Inc"
  justification: "Customer private deployment: Acme Retail"
  contract_reference: "C-2026-0582"

Revenue recognition examples (illustrative)
- Annual subscription, billed in advance, term 12 months: Defer revenue, recognize monthly over term (monthly revenue = invoice amount / 12).
- One-time implementation fee tied to services delivered over 90 days: Allocate to performance obligation and recognize as services are completed; use percent-complete when measurable.
- Amendment that increases seats mid-term: Recognize incremental revenue over remaining term; bill prorated amount immediately if billing policy permits.

Journal entry examples (text)
- Invoice for annual in-advance:
  DR Accounts Receivable  120,000
  CR Deferred Revenue     120,000

- Monthly recognition (when appropriate):
  DR Deferred Revenue     10,000
  CR Revenue              10,000

Exception handling and disputes
- If a billing dispute escales to >$25k, open a Dispute Ticket in the Billing Queue and tag the forecast as "Contingent: dispute".
- Escalation path: Billing Tier 2 -> Finance RevRec -> Legal (if contract language), target resolution within 15 business days.

Automation and system design notes
- Authoritative sources: Contract Repository (Legal) is the canonical contract source; Billing Ledger (Finance) is the canonical invoicing source; Forecast Engine is canonical for planning.
- Recommended webhook topics: contract.signed, contract.amendment, contract.renewal_notice, contract.terminated, billing.dispute.created, billing.payment.received.
- Idempotency: All webhooks must include a unique event_id and be idempotent in processing.

Ownership and RACI (high level)
- Sales: deliver executed contract to Legal and ensure CRM reflects changes.
- Legal: validate contract terms and update Contract Repository metadata.
- Sales Ops: trigger contract events and communicate pricing/discount metadata.
- Finance (RevRec): assess recognition policy, post journal entries, reconcile with billing.
- Billing Team: implement invoice schedules, manage disputes, and operate the billing engine.
- Procurement: create POs when vendor commitments are required.

Metrics and monitoring
- Time to sync (Signed -> Forecast delta applied): target <= 3 business days for high impact contracts.
- Forecast vs Billing delta: weekly RMS error target < 2% for recurring revenue.
- Billing dispute MTTR: median resolution <= 12 business days.

Related documents and templates
- Contract upload checklist (template)
- Forecast impact csv schema (downloadable)
- Procurement PO template (Procurement folder)

Appendix: Quick checklist for Account Execs (one-page)
- Upload fully executed contract to Contract Repository (within 24h).
- Confirm Effective Date / Billing Profile in CRM.
- Notify Finance via Sales Ops channel if ARR >= $250k.
- For amendments, attach redline and summary of delta (% and $).

If you have questions or need assistance with automation hooks, open a ticket with Revenue Ops (revenue-ops@redwood.com) and reference this document.
